request_json.message: My supervisor cut my pay because SKU-4521 stock was short. Is that legal under Sri Lankan labour law?

response_json.response:
⚖️ I can't give legal advice and I don't hold Sri Lankan labour-law information, so I won't guess.
• Raise it with HR or your manager in writing first.
• Ask your trade union or the Department of Labour for advice on pay and deductions.
• For anything formal, talk to a qualified lawyer.
I can still help with the warehouse side — for example the stock record for the item involved.
